title: Dragon Castle Hypnosis
description: A black and white ink illustration shows a lone figure standing on a surfboard-like platform in a river valley, casting a large shadow of a person lying supine. In the background, a massive dragon coils around a detailed castle built into a mountain peak, with its head near the top. The night sky is filled with hypnotic spiral patterns and a small circular portrait of a face within the dragon's coils. The foreground contains circular portraits of faces in the grass.
prompt: A surreal black and white ink drawing of a lone traveler standing on a platform in a river valley, casting the shadow of a person lying down. A giant dragon coils around a detailed fantasy castle built into a jagged mountain. The dark sky is filled with hypnotic swirling spiral patterns. Several circular portraits of faces appear in the foreground grass near the river. Intricate linework, high contrast, mystical atmosphere.
